_schema: 18 Moon/Mars target definitions matching plan.md §2.1 (10 Moon: 9 Artemis regions + Shackleton Connecting Ridge; 8 Mars: Jezero, Gale, Utopia/Zhurong, AP-1, AP-9, EM-16, PM-1, Phoenix). IDs are proposed snake_case (plan.md defines none); rename freely in the data contract. Each target: id, name, body, role, anchor{lat, lon (east-positive -180..180), source_url, note}, sample_radius_km (plan.md: Moon 15, Mars 25), values{temperature_range, illumination, slope, thermal_inertia, ice, elevation[, radiation]} where each value is {value (number, [min,max], string, or null), unit, citation_url, note}. null = not found in literature; the note says which dataset the pipeline should sample. context_values holds nearby or target-card-only facts that must not be scored as the target's own value. body_context holds body-wide reference values. Compiled 2026-10-08 IST by Researcher. Literature values only; nothing sampled or invented. Non-DOI URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-08; DOIs confirmed via the Crossref API (publishers often block automated fetches).

psr_ice_stability_temperature.note: Surfaces below ~110 K keep water ice stable; nearly all PSRs in the Artemis regions are perpetually below 110 K.

ridge_summer_temperature.value: >~120 K (ridge crests, summer); ~200 K summer on Connecting Ridge

equatorial_diurnal_range.note: Williams et al. 2017; not representative of polar targets.

radiation_dose.note: Chang'E-4 LND, far side; applies to first order at all sites.

starship_constraints.value: elevation < -2 km (< -3 km preferred); latitude < 40°; slopes < 5° over 10 m; < 5% chance of a 1 m rock; exclude TI < 100

hls_2015_constraints.value: ±50° latitude; < +2 km MOLA; ~25 km² with slopes < ~10°; no thick fine dust

anchor.note: Centre of IAU feature 'Cabeus B' (USGS/IAU Gazetteer), not an official region polygon; NASA published region outlines only as map images.

temperature_range.note: Per-region value not published; sample Diviner Polar Cumulative Products in the target window (see body_context.moon for regional ranges).

illumination.note: Per-region value not published; sample PGDA product 69 (AVGVISIB) in the target window.

slope.note: Per-region slope statistics not published; compute low-slope fraction from PGDA 90 / LOLA polar slope. Lander requirement ≤8° (goal ≤5°) is in body_context.moon.

thermal_inertia.note: No published thermal inertia per region; plan uses Diviner rock abundance + regolith temperature anomaly (within-body classes).

ice.note: No region-specific ice abundance published; use PSR fraction + Ice Favorability Index in the window. Nearly all PSRs in the Artemis regions stay below 110 K (Williams et al. 2023).

elevation.note: Not compiled; sample LOLA polar DEM (relief matters, not absolute elevation).

lcross_ice_cabeus.note: Measured in the LCROSS impact plume at Cabeus crater (IAU centre -85.33, -42.13), ~3° south of this anchor; context, not a value for the region itself.

lend_hydrogen.note: Sanin et al. 2012; context for nearby Cabeus PSR.

thermal_inertia.note: Site value not compiled; sample TES TI (Putzig & Mellon 2007, https://se.psi.edu/inertia/2007/) in the window.

ice.note: Equatorial site; no shallow ice expected per SWIM coverage (not quantified here).

scoring_constants.note: Full float64 precision. All quantiles are cos(lat) area-weighted over the cells of earth_features.bin as decoded (raw * scale + add_offset), midpoint (Hazen) interpolation of the weighted CDF, NaN skipped. Target values in features.*.value / t_star are unrounded; t_star = min(max(value, p0_5), p99_5).

range_norm.rule: s = max(0, 1 - |x - t_star| / (p99 - p01)); if p99 == p01: 1 on exact match else 0
range_norm.design_note: Intended (review M3): t* is clipped to Earth's P0.5/P99.5, so for targets beyond Earth's range every target rewards closeness to the same Earth extreme (F2 t* = P99.5 for all 18 targets). Cells farther than one P1-P99 span from t* get s = 0 and hit the 0.01 floor of the geometric mean; zero_share_of_land gives that share per target (cos(lat) area-weighted).

mars.missing: aridity_index NaN fails A and the AI part of D; NaN barren/permafrost/moss/flags read as 0

scoring_constants.f7_note: F7 has no target value (null on every target): it is scored Earth-only as the area-weighted aridity percentile.
